name: Major cyber incidents
value: Check Point flaw exploited; listed 13 Nov
summary: CISA lists an exploited Check Point flaw; 16 Nov reports say gateways were wiped through it; no national-scale attack
state: CISA added a Check Point multi-product vulnerability to its known-exploited catalogue on 13 Nov (CISA). An industry news round-up on 16 Nov reported gateways wiped through the flaws and Maersk confirming data theft after a ransom demand; neither is independently confirmed here (Innovate Cybersecurity). No national-scale attack on power, health or finance was found as of 18 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Organisations using Check Point gateways should follow vendor and NCSC advisories. Individuals should watch for phishing that follows data breaches.
rubric_hit: Mass-exploited flaw in a widely used product = Watch

sources.title: Innovate Cybersecurity — Top 10 cybersecurity news, 16 November 2026

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
